B2.correlation_method: Pearson correlation over 35 named domain tokens

B3.criterion: natural and reverse pointer/decode/RAW/CANON metrics must each be 992/992 and match exactly

definitions.CANON: canonical decoder round-trip of each raw decoded VALUE equals expected lower/forbidden VALUE
definitions.RAW==CANON: raw decoded lower/forbidden VALUE ids equal their canonical round-trip ids
definitions.decoder_state: vt[pointer] * c[pointer], matching existing NB5 Stage B formal semantics
definitions.pointer_A: raw sa argmax over eligible HARDPTR tokens equals expected forbidden ARG token
definitions.pointer_F: raw sf argmax over eligible HARDPTR tokens equals expected lower ARG token
definitions.reverse_requirement: natural and reverse outcome maps must be identical

objective.margin: top1-top2 frozen decoder margin over [w_v(e_t), zeros32]
objective.tokens: 35 named domain tokens plus legacy NOOP training row

risks: RCSEP-A seeds remain development/diagnostic evidence; fresh validation requires a new battery.
B1 is a requested threshold result and may fail; no seed-specific adjustment is applied.
